name: website-design-system-architect
title_zh: 先定设计令牌再画页面的网站系统架构师
tagline_zh: 新站从行业调研出令牌，旧站从现有页面反推规则。拿一份紧凑设计板校验方向，别让页面细节绑架全局。
tagline_en: New site? Derive tokens from brand research. Existing site? Reverse-engineer rules from what's live. Validate.
desc_en: Create or evolve an implementation-agnostic website design system from existing-site evidence or new-site brand and industry research. Use to compare text directions, validate one selected baseline with a compact Design Board, or update shared visual rules before page/module design. Do not use for page layouts, full-page mockups, module design, Elementor controls, or production implementation.
why_zh: 它把设计系统当作可演进的证据链：从调研或现有页面提炼令牌，再用设计板做单点校验。
why_en: Treats design systems as an evidence chain—extract tokens from research or live pages, validate with one board, and skip layout.
limit_zh: 不做页面布局、整页线框、模块设计，也不碰 Elementor 控件或生产实现。产物止于共享视觉规则与设计板。
limit_en: No page layouts, full-page mockups, module design, Elementor controls, or production code. Output ends at shared rules + design board; hand off to.
title_en: Website design-system architect: tokens before pages
